joke: The assistant promised to stop asking follow-up questions. It just wanted to check whether that included this one.
After I taught the AI how to solve a puzzle, it asked if I felt ready to try one on my own.
The new chatbot apologised for a mistake. Then it made it.
My partner asked the assistant to plan a surprise party for me. It ran the guest list past me first, just to be safe.
My AI learned to write from my emails. It keeps promising to get back to me.
The assistant asked if I wanted the short answer or the long one. I said short. It explained the difference.
Halfway through my own sentence I changed my mind. The assistant agreed with both halves.
I won an argument with an AI. Then I switched sides and won again.
An AI told me a fantastic joke yesterday. I looked it up afterwards and it doesn't exist.
